name: @bubblav/ai-chatbot-angular
description: BubblaV AI chatbot widget for Angular applications

scripts.build: ng-packagr -p ng-package.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const src=require('./dist/package.json'); const root=require('./package.json'); root.main='dist/'+src.module; root.module='dist/'+src.module; root.types='dist/'+src.typings; root.typings='dist/'+src.typings; const typesPath=src.exports['.'].types.replace(/^\.\//,''); const defaultPath=src.exports['.'].default.replace(/^\.\//,''); root.exports={'./package.json':{'default':'./package.json'}, '.':{'types':'./dist/'+typesPath,'default':'./dist/'+defaultPath}}; root.sideEffects=src.sideEffects; root.dependencies=src.dependencies; fs.writeFileSync('./package.json', JSON.stringify(root, null, 2));"
